title: Paramedic
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

outcomes: Apply advanced-level emergency medical knowledge and standards within the paramedic scope of practice to the care of patients in a diverse community.
Apply safe advanced-level technical skills in emergency medical situations within the paramedic scope of practice.
Behave professionally, skillfully, and in a manner consistent with employer and community expectations of an Emergency Medical Services (EMS) provider.
Support patient advocacy and inter professional collaboration in prehospital care to address health disparities in a diverse community.

notes: The requested award is a Certificate of Achievement, but the source page is titled 'Paramedic AS' and prints only the A.S. degree requirements; no separate certificate section appears. The 47-unit core was recorded as the award's requirements; a reviewer should confirm that the certificate shares this core.

Degree total 69 is printed as 'TOTAL Units 69' (Required Major Total 47 + 'Additional GE & electives 22'). ge_units 22 is taken from that combined 'GE & electives' line and from the Pre Program pathway total of 22 credits of AVC GE areas. The page does not split GE from electives.
ge_pattern recorded as 'AVC GE' from the pathway's 'Any AVC GE Area' entries; the page does not name the pattern formally.
The closed list stores the code as 'EMT130B' with no units; the catalog prints EMT 130B (also 'EMT130B') with 11 units. It was treated as the same course, not a catalog addition.
EMT 130A's title appears as 'Paramedic Clinical Practicum' in one table and as 'Paramedic Clinical Education' in the Requirements table.
The outcomes were taken from the 'Learning Outcomes' list. A second 'Program Outcomes' list for Paramedic AS repeats them but is cut off mid-text in the fourth outcome.
Employers named (fire department, private ambulance service, third service, hospital) were not recorded as careers. The exit levels (AEMT, EMT, EMR) were also not recorded as careers.
